integrity: Full proof and a separate standalone standard-library verifier; bounded computations do not certify asymptotic theorems.
scientific_limitations: Complete equal-energy dense network, bounded strictly positive exchangeable edge pairs independent across unordered pairs; convergence is quenched-network ensemble, not a dynamical time CLT. Potential broader unlocated invariant-vector results and no independent audit.
title: Gaussian stationary-occupation fluctuations detect antisymmetric disorder on dense networks
